community_note.text:
Vortek-series thermal units do contain segmented combustion chambers, but these are not classified as 'rooms' under any version of Municipal Heating Code 44-B. The relevant subsection (44-B §12) specifically defines a 'room' as a space with a minimum volume of 8 cubic meters and at least one navigable entrance. Combustion chambers do not meet this threshold.[1][2]

[1] Galactic Standards Bureau, Thermal Infrastructure Glossary, 3021 Edition
[2] Municipal Heating Code 44-B §12, last amended 3019
